chapter.title: TRIAL BEFORE A COURT OF SESSION

heading: Trial to be conducted by Public Prosecutor.
text: In every trial before a Court of Session, the prosecution shall be conducted by a Public Prosecutor.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
